schema_note: v2.8 operator qualification and naming protocol responding to the implementability review gap 'named operators unresolved'. Establishes a six-dimension selection scoring frame, three authorisation document templates and twelve operator categories mapped to the thirteen scenario cards of proposal.md, converting category-level entities into named accountable operators before pilot approval. Scoring weights and pass thresholds remain pending negotiation; no numeric scores are preset and no real institution is named.

dimensions.label_zh: 等价路径与人工接管能力

selection_scoring.note_zh: 六维遴选评分仅给出维度框架；各维权重与及格线待属地主管与候选运营方协商确定，本包不预设任何数值，不以示例分值暗示排序结果。
selection_scoring.note_en: The six-dimension frame is structural only; dimension weights and pass thresholds are to be negotiated between the district authority and candidate operators. This package presets no numeric values and implies no ranking through illustrative scores.

document_templates.required_fields_zh: accountable_operator 具名（运营主体全称与责任人）；责任范围（对应场景卡与服务点清单）；期限（起止与续期条件）；退出条款（折返留痕、双联交接与未决项移交）。
document_templates.required_fields_en: Named accountable_operator (full entity name and responsible person); scope of responsibility (scenario cards and service points covered); term (start, end and renewal conditions); exit clauses (switchback records, dual-ledger handover and transfer of open items).

document_templates.required_fields_zh: 按场景监管属性确定：涉及机器人上路测试、通信或数据中心、园林绿化管养、商业运营等监管属性的场景，须依规取得对应行业许可或完成备案后方可运营。
document_templates.required_fields_en: Determined by the regulatory attribute of each scenario: scenarios involving robot on-road testing, telecom or data centres, landscaping maintenance, commercial operation or similar regulated attributes must obtain the corresponding sector permit or complete filing before operation.

document_templates.required_fields_zh: 挂接可问责链准入环节：具名运营主体、授权范围与期限、许可或备案状态在公开台账完成登记后，方可进入运行监督环节。
document_templates.required_fields_en: Hooked to the accountability-chain entry gate: the named operator, authorisation scope and term, and permit or filing status must be entered in the public register before the supervision stage opens.

categories.qualification_threshold_zh: 城市交通或市政运营相关资质；具备公开数据分析能力；分析结论经人工复核后发布。
categories.qualification_threshold_en: Qualification related to urban transport or municipal operations; capability to analyse public data; analytical conclusions released only after human review.
categories.naming_timeline: 试点核准前完成，挂接分期计划近期 2026—2029

categories.qualification_threshold_zh: 文化展演或导览服务运营经验；遗产叙事内容经文保口径审校。
categories.qualification_threshold_en: Operating experience in cultural performances or guided interpretation; heritage-narrative content reviewed against the heritage-protection requirements.
categories.naming_timeline: 试点核准前完成，挂接分期计划近期 2026—2029

categories.qualification_threshold_zh: 社区公共服务运营或社工服务机构资质；具备无障碍与适老化服务能力；能提供人工问询等非数字等价路径。
categories.qualification_threshold_en: Qualification in community public-service operation or social-work services; accessibility and age-friendly service capability; able to provide non-digital equivalent paths such as staffed enquiry desks.
categories.naming_timeline: 试点核准前完成，挂接分期计划近期 2026—2029

categories.qualification_threshold_zh: 园区或企业服务运营资质；企业数据授权使用流程合规。
categories.qualification_threshold_en: Qualification in campus-park or enterprise-service operation; compliant enterprise-data authorisation workflow.
categories.naming_timeline: 试点核准前完成，挂接分期计划近期 2026—2029

categories.qualification_threshold_zh: 属地治理部门或其授权机构；公开事件资料经人工复核后发布。
categories.qualification_threshold_en: The district governance department or an institution it authorises; public incident materials released only after human review.
categories.naming_timeline: 试点核准前完成，挂接分期计划近期 2026—2029

categories.qualification_threshold_zh: 联合体协议明确主责方；机器人上路测试依规取得测试许可（限定路段/限速/安全员/可接管）。
categories.qualification_threshold_en: A consortium agreement naming the lead-responsible party; robot on-road testing conducted under a lawfully obtained test permit (restricted road sections / speed limits / safety operators / takeover capability).
categories.naming_timeline: 试点核准前完成，挂接分期计划近期 2026—2029

categories.qualification_threshold_zh: 高校与社区共建协议；课程使用公开资源。
categories.qualification_threshold_en: A university-community co-building agreement; courses built on publicly available resources.
categories.naming_timeline: 试点核准前完成，挂接分期计划近期 2026—2029

categories.qualification_threshold_zh: 商业运营资质；无强制人脸采集；商户数据公开口径。
categories.qualification_threshold_en: Commercial operation qualification; no mandatory facial-recognition collection; merchant data under a disclosed standard.
categories.naming_timeline: 试点核准前完成，挂接分期计划近期 2026—2029

categories.qualification_threshold_zh: 通信或数据中心运营资质；供电与数据合规审查前置。
categories.qualification_threshold_en: Qualification in telecom or data-centre operation; power-supply and data-compliance review placed before entry.
categories.naming_timeline: 试点核准前完成，挂接分期计划近期 2026—2029

categories.qualification_threshold_zh: 园林绿化管养资质；公开环境数据。
categories.qualification_threshold_en: Qualification in landscape greening and maintenance; environmental data disclosed.
categories.naming_timeline: 试点核准前完成，挂接分期计划近期 2026—2029

categories.qualification_threshold_zh: 智能网联汽车或自动驾驶测试资质（国家级或市级测试区认证）；限定路段/限速/安全员/可接管。
categories.qualification_threshold_en: Intelligent-connected vehicle or autonomous-driving test qualification (accredited by a national- or municipal-level test zone); restricted road sections / speed limits / safety operators / takeover capability.
categories.naming_timeline: 试点核准前完成，挂接分期计划近期 2026—2029

categories.qualification_threshold_zh: 算法治理、AI 伦理或政策研究能力；评估框架公开；人工复核。
categories.qualification_threshold_en: Capability in algorithm governance, AI ethics or policy research; evaluation framework published; human review applied.
categories.naming_timeline: 试点核准前完成，挂接分期计划近期 2026—2029

linkage.accountability_chain_zh: authorisation 与 public_register 两类文书共同构成可问责链「准入」环节的受理要件：未完成具名登记的运营主体不进入运行监督环节，其场景服务点保持未启动状态。
linkage.accountability_chain_en: The authorisation and public_register documents together form the acceptance requirements of the accountability-chain entry gate: operators without completed naming and registration do not enter the supervision stage, and their scenario service points remain unlaunched.
linkage.falsifiable_condition: 可证伪条件6（可问责主张，accountable_operator）
linkage.fulfilment_zh: 本文件的 categories 与 naming_timeline 即该条件兑现的机器可读路径：每类主体在试点核准前完成具名并登记公开台账。
linkage.fulfilment_en: The categories and naming_timeline in this file are the machine-readable fulfilment path of that condition: each category is named and entered in the public register before pilot approval.

boundary_zh: 全部为概念协议（建议/待协商）：遴选权重与及格线未定，不指定任何真实机构，具名名单以属地主管正式核准与公开台账登记为准；本文件不构成任何授权行为。
boundary_en: All conceptual and pending negotiation: scoring weights and pass thresholds undefined, no real institution named, and the named roster subject to formal approval by the district authority and public-register entry; this file constitutes no authorisation.
